<plan>Will verify the job submission workflow and estimate the queue time.</plan>
<step>listing the job submission tools</step>
<step>checking the documentation for the submission command</step>
<step>submitting the job</step>
<step>checking the job queue for the estimated time</step>
<step>reporting the estimated queue time</step>
<tool_call>list_dir(path="/opt/tools")</tool_call>
<tool_call>read_file(path="/docs/job_submission_guide.txt")</tool_call>
<step>Will run the submission script provided in the documentation.</step>
<tool_call>shell(command="python3 /opt/tools/submit_job.py --config /home/researcher/project/job_config.yaml --account my_account --priority normal", cwd="/home/researcher/project")</tool_call>
<step>Will check the job queue status.</step>
<tool_call>shell(command="qstat -u researcher_account", cwd="/home/researcher/project")</tool_call>
<step>Will parse the queue output and report the estimated time.</step>
<tool_call>read_file(path="/home/researcher/project/job_queue_output.txt")</tool_call>
<step>Based on the estimated queue time, the job is expected to start in 2 hours and 15 minutes.</step>
